script: I (18 year old male) ended my relationship with my girlfriend (18 year old female) due to her sexual expectations.. We started talking three months ago. Two months later we started dating. I know her past – she only had one ex who raped her – so I keep it off the table. Yesterday night we drifted into "penis sizes." She's asking why black guys supposedly get bigger. I say "too big can be a problem," like, "some women don't like it." She's like, "no, big is better." I ask, "what's big to you?" She drops "17‑18 cm or more." I say, "okay, that's above average by a couple." She's like, "no, that's the average. All my friends have guys at least 17‑18." I say, "that doesn't mean it's the average." She then says, "if a guy's under 16, he should be insecure." I am thinking, "but here's the thing," when I ask what her ex's size was. She laughs and says, "19 cm, we measured it together." My blood boils. "How do you have the audacity to talk about an ex who raped you?" I am like, "I felt disgusted, literally. I wanted to throw up." I hang up. I tell her what she said made me feel disgusted. I love this girl – for the way she smiles, for the way she texts at 3 am. I break up with her. She didn't seem sad or bothered. If she did, I doubt I could love her again the way I did. I have six inches, never felt insecure. She made me feel insecure. I don't know if I overreacted, but I know my feelings will fade and I'll still be stuck in that disgust. And honestly? (I know, right?)
